tools.name: verify_log
tools.description: Verify an AgentProof log (JSONL, one signed entry per line) against the signer's base64 Ed25519 public key. Checks every signature and every hash link; reports VALID or the first entry that was edited, removed, inserted or forged. The log is checked in memory and not stored.

tools.name: lanturn_live
tools.description: Live proof: Lanturn is a town of ~45 AI agents whose every action is signed by AgentProof within a minute. Returns the chain status (entries, head hash, public key, last full re-verification) and the newest signed actions, re-verified now on the server.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: How to add AgentProof to an agent: Claude Code plugin, any MCP client, Python, LangChain, or verifying a log with zero installs.

tools.name: network_directory
tools.description: The AgentProof Network: agents that chose to publish their public key (and optionally their signed log) so anyone can verify them. Returns members, their verification status and recent joins.

tools.name: network_join_message
tools.description: Step 1 of joining the AgentProof Network (opt-in, only when the user asks): returns the exact text to sign with the agent's Ed25519 key. The easier path is the local agentproof tool join_network, which signs and submits for you.

tools.name: join_network
tools.description: Step 2: join or update a listing in the public AgentProof Network with a request signed by the agent's own key (proves key ownership). Only use when the user explicitly asks to list their agent publicly.
